Multi-record tapes open with every record checked. **Play Whole Tape** plays them in tape order. Uncheck any records you want to skip, or choose **Select whole tape** to check them all again. Each record shows its type and loading hint.

**Short transfer (single blocks)** is the startup default. **Ask before next record** is the default between records; choose **Wait 5 seconds** to continue automatically.

Download **MZT-Player-1.5.0-macOS-arm64.zip** for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains the archive checksum. The build is ad hoc signed and not Apple-notarised.
